source_name: Soybean Processors Association of India (SOPA), oil marketing year 2024-25 (Oct 2024–Sep 2025), as reported by Outlook Business / DPRJ Universal
notes: Named as India's top 5 soybean-meal export destinations for OMY 2024-25, jointly accounting for ~55% of total export volume — but the source gave no individual per-country volume or USD value, so those fields are left null rather than estimated. Aggregate: total exports fell 11% YoY to 20.23 lakh tonnes (2.023 million MT) in OMY2024-25, down from 2.275 million MT the prior year, attributed to Indian soybean meal being priced above US/Brazil/Argentina competition. No USD export value was found in the sources checked for this session — recommend a follow-up query directly to SOPA (sopa.org) or DGCI&S for the value figure before this anchors a priced blog post.
